name: File browser mobile
description:
5-line summary of the conversation:

1. **Single-panel mobile mode** — On phones and portrait tablets the File Explorer now shows one full-width panel, starting on the file tree, switching to the file when one is opened and back to the tree when the last tab is closed (`FileExplorerPanel.vue`, `TabManager.vue`).
2. **Icon view added** — A list/grid toggle was introduced in the files tree toolbar, rendering the same entries as icon tiles (with match-count badges for content search) while reusing all existing click, selection, context-menu and drag/drop logic (`FileExplorer.vue`).
3. **Full-width tree when empty** — The desktop splitter's right (file) panel is now provided only while a file is open, so the tree fills the full width whenever no tab exists, in every viewport (`FileExplorerPanel.vue`).
4. **Drag & drop reorganization** — Files and folders can be moved into other folders or up to the `..` parent (in both list and grid views), implemented via the existing `files.rename` endpoint with multi-select support and self/descendant-drop guards (`FileExplorer.vue`).
5. **Architecture** — All changes were minimal, kept state alive where needed, reused DaisyUI/Tailwind components and existing API primitives, and required no new dependencies or backend changes.

messages.content: Add icon view in files tree navigation

## 1. Analysis & Pre-Thinking **Core Requirements** - Add an **icon (grid) view** to the files tree navigation in `FileExplorer.vue`. - User must be able to toggle between the existing **list view** and the new **icon/grid view**. - Both views must preserve the existing behavior: navigation into folders, opening files, multi-select, context menu, drag & drop, search results and content-search previews. **Strategic Approach** 1. Add a single reactive `viewMode` state (`'list'` | `'grid'`), defaulting to the current list view so nothing changes for existing users. 2. Add a small **view-toggle button** in the existing toolbar (next to the search-scope and refresh buttons) using a Font Awesome icon that reflects the *current* mode. 3. Keep the existing list markup untouched but gate it with `v-else-if="viewMode === 'list'"`, and add a new `v-else` **grid branch** that renders the same `visibleEntries` as icon tiles. 4. Reuse the exact same handlers (`handleEntryClick`, `onEntryContextMenu`, drag/drop handlers, `getFileIcon`, selection classes) so no logic is duplicated — only the presentation differs. **Dependencies & Risks** - `getFileIcon()` returns icon *classes* that already include color but no size → the grid tile supplies its own `text-4xl` size. - The `..` parent row and the empty state must be reproduced in the grid branch to keep parity. - Content-search results carry `entry.matches` → in grid view we show a compact match-count badge instead of the multi-line preview. - No new dependencies; no store changes; layout unaffected. **Target Files** - `src/components/filebrowser/FileExplorer.vue` (modify) ## 2. Minimum Changes Approach - **Toolbar (~line 60):** insert a view-mode toggle button before the refresh button. - **Tree listing container:** change the list wrapper from `v-else` to `v-else-if="viewMode === 'list'"` and add a new sibling `v-else` grid branch (parent tile + icon tiles + empty state). - **`data()`:** add `viewMode: 'list'`. - **`methods`:** add `toggleViewMode()`. ## 3. File Change Summary | File Path | Action | Component / Section | Change Description | | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | | `src/components/filebrowser/FileExplorer.vue` | Modify | `template` → toolbar | Added a view-mode toggle button (grid/list icon) next to the search-scope and refresh buttons. | | `src/components/filebrowser/FileExplorer.vue` | Modify | `template` → listing | Gated the existing list markup with `v-else-if="viewMode === 'list'"`. | | `src/components/filebrowser/FileExplorer.vue` | Modify | `template` → listing | Added a new `v-else` icon/grid view: auto-fill responsive grid of tiles (large icon + name + size, badge for content-search matches), plus a `..` parent tile and empty state. | | `src/components/filebrowser/FileExplorer.vue` | Modify | `data.viewMode` | New state `viewMode: 'list'` (defaults to current behavior). | | `src/components/filebrowser/FileExplorer.vue` | Modify | `methods.toggleViewMode` | New method switching `viewMode` between `'list'` and `'grid'`. | ### Notes on behavior - **Non-destructive default:** the explorer still opens in list view; users opt into the icon view via the new toggle. - **Parity:** the grid tiles reuse the exact same click, context-menu and drag/drop handlers, so navigation, opening files (which triggers the mobile single-panel flow from the previous change), selection highlighting and drag-to-folder all behave identically. - **Content search:** instead of the multi-line preview, grid tiles surface a `badge` with the number of matches — the detail preview remains available in list view. - **Responsive:** the grid uses `grid-cols-[repeat(auto-fill,minmax(96px,1fr))]` so tiles reflow from a couple of columns on phones up to many columns on wide screens without fixed widths.

**5-Line Summary**

1. **Request**: On mobile and portrait-tablet viewports, the file explorer should use a single full-width panel — starting on the file tree, switching to the file when a file is opened, and returning to the tree when the file is closed.
2. **Exploration**: Reviewed `FileExplorerPanel.vue`, `TabManager.vue`, `VerticalSplitter.vue`, `FileViewer.vue`, and the `ui` store to understand the existing split layout and the `$ui.isMobile` breakpoint (`width <= 1024`).
3. **Approach**: Desktop/landscape keeps the resizable `VerticalSplitter`; mobile/portrait renders one full-width container where `FileExplorer` and `TabManager` both stay mounted and toggle via `v-show` using a `mobileView` state (`'tree'` | `'file'`).
4. **Changes**: Added `emits: ['tab-open', 'tabs-empty']` to `TabManager` (emitted in `addTab`, `closeTab`, and `closeAllTabs`), and added `isSinglePanel`, `mobileView`, `onTabOpen`, and `onTabsEmpty` to `FileExplorerPanel.vue`.
5. **Outcome**: Mobile/portrait users get a clean single-panel flow (tree → file → tree) while preserving tree state and open tabs, with desktop/landscape behavior unchanged.

1. **Mobile/portrait single-panel layout**: Modified `FileExplorerPanel.vue` and `TabManager.vue` so viewports ≤1024px use one full-width panel — starting on the file tree, switching to the open file on click, and reverting to the tree when all tabs close (via new `tab-open`/`tabs-empty` events), while desktop keeps the `VerticalSplitter`.

2. **Icon view for the file tree**: Added a `viewMode` (`'list'` | `'grid'`) state plus a toolbar toggle button in `FileExplorer.vue`.

3. The new grid branch renders responsive icon tiles (auto-fill, min 96px) reusing existing click, context-menu, selection, and drag/drop handlers for full behavioral parity.

4. Content-search results show a match-count badge in grid view, while the detailed multi-line preview stays in list view.

5. List view remains the default, so existing behavior is unchanged unless the user opts into the icon view.

1. **Mobile/portrait single-panel layout:** On viewports ≤1024px the file explorer shows one full-width panel starting on the file tree; opening a file hides the tree and shows the file, and closing all tabs brings the tree back.
2. **Tab lifecycle events:** `TabManager.vue` gained `tab-open` and `tabs-empty` emits (fired in `addTab`, `closeTab`, and `closeAllTabs`) so parents can react to open/close state.

5. **Safe remounting:** `handleFileOpen`/`handleCreateFile` delegate to an `openTab()` helper that awaits `$nextTick()` before calling `addTab`, keeping the always-mounted `FileExplorer` state intact.
